name: Gale Reef
description: Gale Reef - A relaxing dive spot known for its clear water and colorful coral reefs.
details: This location is perfect for beginners and casual divers who want an easy, enjoyable dive with plenty of marine life to see.

name: Dawson’s Reef
description: Dawson’s Reef - A more adventurous dive site with deeper waters and stronger currents.
details: This reef is best suited for experienced divers who enjoy a challenge and want to explore a wide variety of underwater scenery.

name: Claire’s REEF
description: Claire’s REEF - A peaceful reef surrounded by rock formations and schools of tropical fish.
details: It’s a great choice for divers who prefer a slower pace, scenic views, and opportunities for underwater photography.
